verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs directly claim it is 'typically among the first providers to deploy a newly released model' and describe the platform as making it simple to run 'the latest machine learning models.' That speaks to the core of the story, but it is a single, unquantified vendor claim. missing for 10: concrete day-0/time-to-availability figures or examples of specific model launches, independent or hands-on corroboration of release speed, documentation of how new models are announced or added to the catalog.
